ache.title: He *thought* he’d quit. Trying still counts
ache.note: Unscripted and candid: juggling Star Rail, Genshin and Sword of Convallaria was eating his life and resources, and he felt the toll on his mental health. The asterisk on “thought” is honest, because quitting often takes more than one go. This is the brave part. If you see yourself here, you’re not late. You’re right on time.
ache.tip: If one try at quitting didn’t stick, that’s normal. Try again, and maybe tell someone this time.
lines: three games at once? no wonder he was tired
*thought*. the asterisk is doing the work
trying counts. I’m... a bit proud. shh

title: Why I *Thought* I'd Quit Gacha Games
excerpt: In this unscripted video, I share my candid thoughts and emotions about a monumental decision to leave gacha games behind. I discuss how managing multiple games like Honkai Star Rail, Genshin Impact, and Sword of Convallaria was consuming my life and resources. Realizing the negative impact on my mental health, I've decided to explore other gaming genres and focus on what truly makes me happy. Join me in this new chapter, and let's continue sharing our experiences and passions for gaming.
